parameters.content:
## I.AP — ActiveProspect Intake (v1.1 · 2026-09-08)

**What it does.** ActiveProspect (LeadConduit) delivers each purchased lead here as JSON *after* its own DNC / duplicate / litigator / TrustedForm gates and *after* the Lead Perfection Form POST succeeds. This workflow creates the GHL contact in seconds instead of waiting for the LP sync + 15-min intake backstop.

**It never sends the lead to Lead Perfection.** ActiveProspect already did (flow step 12). The contact is tagged `lp-linked` and never enrolled in I.LP-OUT.

**It writes the REAL source, and does NOT decide entry tags.** v1.0 hardcoded `entry:other` — wrong (Google PPC Windows maps to high-intent-digital, Angie to unmapped, etc.). v1.1 writes the vendor where the system reads it: custom field **LP Subsource** (`o8h88WeFST8euBUq3Av6`) = vendor name exactly as in `lp_source_mapping.lp_source_subdetail`, **LP Source** (`IvSDubMH0FmZmlCDy5C2`) = channel (default `Internet`), `contact.source` = vendor, plus `source:<channel>` and `source:<channel>-<vendor>` tags. Then it calls LP-MCP `POST /webhook/ghl/ensure-routing-tags`, whose map-driven resolver (`ENTRY_RESOLVER_MAP_DRIVEN=true`, `src/entry-source-map.js`) reads LP Subsource → `lp_source_mapping` and writes `entry:*`, `active-entry:*`, `intent-bucket:*` via the action executor. A vendor missing from the table resolves to `other` by heuristic — add the row to `lp_source_mapping` and it self-corrects on the next lead.

**Always-tags:** `ap-intake-created` (provenance, distinct from `lp-backstop-created` / `lp-inbound`) · `lp-linked` · `stage:new-lead`.

**Routing.** GHL native `contact.created` → LP-MCP → agent rule 355 `INTAKE_ROUTE_BACKSTOP_OTHER` (to be widened to `ap-intake-created`) → E.5 for `active-entry:other`. Other buckets (high-intent-digital, risk-report, chatbot) route via the I.AC / `ghl.contact_created` hygiene family like any other new contact. No routing logic lives here.

**Find-before-create.** Search GHL by phone (last-10 verified). Match → link only: add intake note, never re-tag. No match → create. GHL duplicate-400 → link to `meta.contactId`.

**Response codes.** 200 = created/linked. 400 = no usable phone. 500 = GHL create failed → ActiveProspect marks it failed for resend (safe: dedupe by phone).

**DNC re-entry (2026-09-28).** On a match (link branch) it also POSTs to LP-MCP `/webhook/ap/dnc-reentry`. If the matched contact is on DNC, LP-MCP asks a person in #dnc-lift-approval (Approve Lift / Keep Blocked). It only asks; nothing is lifted without a click.

nodes.notes: 2026-09-28 Consent Model v1. Link branch only (lead matched an existing contact). LP-MCP checks whether that contact is on DNC and, if so, asks a person in #dnc-lift-approval. Runs after ActiveProspect already got its 200; never blocks or fails a delivery.
